long_biography.plain_text:
Businessman Igor Makarov competed for the Soviet national cycling team before entering commerce. His involvement in the sport later extended to funding and governance: he founded and sponsored the Katusha professional team and served on the management committee of the Union Cycliste Internationale. His companies also supported European cycling federations, while his later sponsorship included races and charity rides in Cyprus.

Through the Makarov Foundation, he helped establish the Adult Autism Clinic at Mount Sinai Medical Center in Miami Beach. The clinic provides primary and specialist care for adults on the autism spectrum, with dedicated appointment hours, a sensory-friendly waiting area and staff trained to accommodate patients’ needs. Its services address the transition from paediatric to adult medical care.
